Internally, the company offers career growth and a dynamic culture for many employees, though a subset mentions high-pressure environments and managerial shortcomings. If you’re considering a program, research the specific course and location carefully, ask for concrete placement stats, read recent reviews from students in that batch, and get all administrative policies (payment, refund, scheduling) in writing before enrolling.
